notes: אִם לֹא → *Surely* is rule 30's named fusion. The one English word writes neither morpheme's lexeme — the oath idiom is positive in English — so rule 6's deterministic fallback puts the source head on the first token; heading on the negative under rule 23 was the competing reading.
עֲטָרוֹת is an adverbial accusative taking the supplied *as* and its indefinite article (rules 33, 15).
